management: Use clean planting material and seek local confirmation before disease-specific action

overview: Sugarcane red rot is a fungal disease. TNAU describes internal red discoloration in split canes, sometimes interrupted by white patches; leaf yellowing and drying may also occur.
symptoms: Split cane may show internal red discoloration with white patches
possible_causes: Colletotrichum falcatum is a commonly used name for the pathogen
spread: Infected setts and crop residues can contribute to spread
prevention: Use disease-free planting material and follow local sanitation guidance
management: Have cane inspected and confirmed locally before taking crop-specific action
professional_help_message: This image classification is not a field diagnosis. Ask a local agricultural extension service or plant diagnostic laboratory to confirm the cause before choosing treatment.

overview: Sugarcane rust affects leaves. TNAU describes small elongated yellow spots that may become brown or reddish-brown, with pustules often beneath leaves.
symptoms: Spots may become brown or reddish-brown
Pustules may appear on the lower leaf surface
management: Confirm locally and follow regional variety and disease-management advice
